snippet.title: Shard Squad - Steam Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience the action-packed gameplay of Shard Squad! Fight off relentless enemies, unlock unique elemental characters, and master powerful abilities.

The demo is coming soon to Steam—add it to your wishlist now and be the first to play!
